title: rule.deadline_changed
description: A newer rule version moved the due date of a published version, for one period of a recurring rule or for a one-off rule. Producer: rulebook (when the causing version is published). Consumers: obligation.
x-producer: rulebook (when the causing version is published)

rule_id.description: The rule of the version whose deadline changed.

rule_version_id.description: The version whose deadline changed; its obligations are the ones to reschedule.

caused_by_rule_version_id.description: The newer version that changes the deadline.

period_label.description: The period whose due date moved, as obligations carry it; null for a one-off rule.

new_due_on.description: The due date after the change.

evidence_clause_id.description: The clause of the causing version's document that states the change.
